# ankra_cluster_agent_auto_upgrade (Resource)

Whether the platform's fleet rollout upgrades a cluster's Ankra agent automatically. The counterpart of `ankra cluster agent auto-upgrade enable` and `disable`. Destroying the resource restores the platform default, automatic upgrades on. The cluster must have a registered agent.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ankra_cluster_agent_auto_upgrade" "prod" {
  cluster_id = "0b6f1d2e-1111-4222-8333-944445555666"
  enabled    = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) Identifier of the cluster. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `enabled` (Boolean) `false` fences the agent off from automatic upgrades.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The cluster id.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Imported by cluster id.
terraform import ankra_cluster_agent_auto_upgrade.prod 0b6f1d2e-1111-4222-8333-944445555666
```
